name: brigade-bridge
description: Let Claude hand tasks to the other apps you have connected to Brigade Bridge, using their existing logins.
long_description: Brigade Bridge connects coding agents such as Codex, Antigravity and Claude Code without API keys. This extension lets Claude Desktop send a task to one of those connected apps and read back the answer. Bridge shows its own approval prompt for sensitive actions, so you stay in control. Requires the Brigade Bridge app to be running on this computer. Copy the local pairing token from Brigade Bridge (Overlay settings) into this extension's settings.

tools.name: bridge_list_nodes
tools.description: List the apps connected to Brigade Bridge that can receive a task

tools.name: bridge_delegate
tools.description: Send a task to a connected app and return its answer

tools.name: bridge_get_result
tools.description: Wait for or check a delegated task

bridge_token.title: Bridge pairing token
bridge_token.description: The local pairing token shown in Brigade Bridge under Overlay settings. It only works on this computer.

bridge_url.title: Bridge address
bridge_url.description: Where Brigade Bridge listens. Leave the default unless you changed it.
